rationale: Separate high/low counts preserve neither ordering nor positional overlap, so they cannot establish a unique offset or date every position of S. No S entry is linked to a dated reference. The docket dates the physical transcription only and cannot license the claimed global chronology.

signal_basis.exact_text: The pattern table lists only separate counts of high and low entries for S and each reference; the export discarded order and position.
The references carry dates, but no S entry is linked to one of them.
The docket is an ordinary documentary date, not an alignment anchor for an identified S increment.
No discriminating offset, overlap-derived exclusion or candidate shift is supplied.
